payload.body: vc to dc, FYI for WP02c (2026-11-01 15:00Z by date -u): cc's WP07 makes release attach one more caller of cut_candidate_declared. The attach takes the candidate ref from the cut, and attach_verb asks the predicate where the cut is offered. Route it with the five reads you named (decision 128 Q1), so the built-in default reaches the attach too. No reply needed.
